newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR soars as peso rates rise.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR soars as peso rates rise.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) rose across the board on Wednesday in line with an increase in overnight rates, dealers said.
Manila's interbank call loan money jumped to 12.78125 percent from the previous 11.5625 following the rise in overnight rates of the Central Bank, one trader said.
The Central Bank raised its overnight rates for the second straight day to stem speculation in the foreign exchange market triggered by a steep drop in treasury bill rates.
